name: gp-language-pack-server
description: Generates and serves language pack downloads from GlotPress translations via the WordPress REST API.

scripts.zip: wp-scripts plugin-zip && mkdir -p deploy && mv gp-language-pack-server.zip deploy/
scripts.release: npm run update-version && npm run build
scripts.betarelease: npm run update-version && npm run build
scripts.version: npm run update-version && git add gp-language-pack-server.php
scripts.build: composer install --no-interaction && npm run make-pot && composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction && npm run zip && composer install --no-interaction
